verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a payments SaaS that holds merchant and transaction data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-usage control. The MCP server and agent-toolkit materials concern AI integrations, not training-data policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
